name: v83_aqi_option_volume_no_eps
hypothesis: Acquisition income contribution and low leverage are stable but crowded when paired with EPS; a light option-breakeven plus return-volume exhaustion sleeve may add orthogonal timing without making option or reversal the parent.
expression: 0.28 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_aqi / assets, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt / assets, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 20), industry) + 0.08 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.06 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part, 126), industry) + 0.12 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(returns * (volume / adv20), 10)) + 0.08 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((high - low) / close, 10)) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Rebuilds d5xj87YE + vRLjkQdw + E5wRYVQR without EPS as a dominant stabilizer; reject if it maps back to 9qwXgvQd, QPa7KOGK, or mL86Jle1.

name: v83_aqi_social_volume_relief
hypothesis: Slow negative-buzz relief is low-correlation but weak alone; paired with acquisition-income/low-debt and small volume exhaustion it may diversify without using fast-news or editorial fields.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_aqi / assets, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt / assets, 126), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.12 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_bfl_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_volume_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.10 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(returns * (volume / adv20), 10)) + 0.06 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_90_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 126), industry)
notes: Uses the low-corr v48 social-relief seed as auxiliary, not the v82 fast editorial route.

name: v83_intangible_margin_option_volume

name: v83_goodwill_delta_option_volume
hypothesis: Falling goodwill relative to assets was strong but crowded with profitability/reversal; a lower-weight version with option/volume/risk sleeves may keep the cleanup signal while changing the PnL shape.
